verdict.rationale: Klaviyo is a SaaS marketing platform with AI features (Composer, K:AI, Customer Agent), so a training opt-out control is a fair question to ask of it. However, no evidence item documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage control, or a no-training policy. API key scopes only limit what third parties can access, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
